pages.text: Keep kitchen tools near the ingredients they process. Give frequently used supplies—such as flour, oils, sweeteners and prepared ingredients—their own storage.$(br2)Use JEI to see which meals share ingredients. Growing a few versatile crops can support many recipes, especially when your kitchen already has the required tools.
Before planting a very large field, choose a few meals you actually want to keep making. Build your crop supply around those recipes, then add variety.
